course_review/1.card_source: none found. golfify's 'sycamore-ridge-golf-club' and AllSquare's page are a different course (Goodview, VA, 9 holes). The build's golfify 'sycamore-ridge-golf-course' card and the OpenGolfAPI record (97e137ae..., par 72, no hole data) were rejected. The club site (sycamoreridgegolf.com) has its scorecard only at /About#scorecard. Card values below are measured from the OSM back tees, with pars from OSM except hole 14 (4).

holes.notes: Straight par 4. OSM hole line, tee and green match the photo. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
Par 5, straight. Routing and green fine. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
Par 3. Green polygon and bunkers match the photo. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
Par 4 played over the pond. The back tee is on the far (south) side of the pond, at the start of the OSM hole line. It looks right. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
Par 3. Green fine. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
Par 5. Routing fine. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
Par 4, gentle dogleg left to G7. Fine. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
Par 3. Green fine. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).

Par 5, dogleg right. The calm pick aims 40 yds right toward the corner; the landing is near the right rough and trees. Plausible, not verified. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).

Par 4. Several tee pads visible; the solved tee is the rearmost, at the hole-line start. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified). qa_rebuild 2026-11-02: Black/Blue colour tags sit two boxes forward (425 / 395 measured vs card 467 / 445); Black moved to the 463 box at the hole-line start. Blue: the tee localizer now prefers the untagged 447 box over the blue tag 50 yds off the card.
Par 5, dogleg left. Driver aimed 32 yds left lands at the corner by the cart path. Plausible. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
Par 4 over a wooded creek ravine to an uphill fairway. Fine. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
Par 3. Green fine. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).

OSM tags hole 14 as par 3, but the tee is 399 yds from the green in the package (404 along the OSM hole line; the page shows 364). It is a par 4. With 14 as a par 4 the course sums to 72, which matches OpenGolfAPI's par 72 for Sycamore Ridge (Spring Hill). The page shows it as a par 3 with a 364-yd 'play it like 393' target box, so a golfer would get no tee-shot pick.
Par 4 from below G14, uphill dogleg left. Fine. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
Par 5 through a wooded corridor. Driver lands where a cart path crosses. Fine. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
Par 3 downhill over water. Fine. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
Par 4, straight. Fine. No scorecard, so the yardage is the OSM back tee (unverified).
